remarks: Enjoy the ease of condo living with the privacy of a single-family home in this freestanding townhouse ideally located on the Old Greenwich-Stamford border. Offering a low-maintenance lifestyle, this residence is perfect as a full-time home or weekend retreat. Conveniently situated close to the train, shops, restaurants, golf, beaches, and major highways. Recent updates include a roof and mechanical systems less than 10 years old. An expansive private patio provides a beautiful setting for relaxing or entertaining outdoors. Interior features include a fireplace, attached garage, full-size washer and dryer, and generous private outdoor space. A rare opportunity to enjoy comfort, convenience, and privacy in an exceptional location.
